scientific_integrity: The all-alphabet theorem is a binary-projection/support reduction to fully exhaustive length-seven five-letter computation. Included Python checker reproduces all small-alphabet collision fiber counts. Self-review completed; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Covers linear words and complete singleton plus distance-at-least-two pair readouts only, for lengths one through seven; it does not determine longer-length fiber sizes or general gap parameters. The underlying binary first collision threshold was previously known. Equivalent alphabet-uniform formulas may occur in literature beyond the inspected sources.
title: Exact short-length \(2\)-gapped pair-deck reconstruction across finite alphabets
